attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It seems the local happenings are not currently worth the ink.","reason":"Invents a reason for the Dispatch stopping reporters to Lowmere; the briefing gives none."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"It opens with a copied heading, which the task forbids. It also squeezes the missing reporter and the ferry burning into one paragraph. Worse, it invents a dull reason for halting Lowmere coverage, then calls the week quiet despite a missing reporter and a pirate arson, which misses the obvious story."}
